complete_examples.text: It is found that properly reducing the stiffness of the under-block pad can effectively reduce the vibration of the track, but it is not conducive to the train running safety.

The emphasis of this study is to identify an optimal damping design value for the under-block pad, a value that enables it to achieve enhanced energy dissipation while maintaining the track's stability to effectively withstand railway traffic loads.
